story: 复利是怎么回事？用每年 5% 收益、本金 1 万元、30 年为例，对比单利和复利的差别，最后提一下 72 法则。

storyboard.title: 复利的魔法：为什么它被称为世界第八大奇迹？
storyboard.logline: 用直观对比和简单计算，讲清复利如何让钱‘生钱’，并揭示72法则背后的数学直觉。

scenes.name: 开场疑问
scenes.description: 纯色浅蓝背景，中央悬浮发光问号，柔和光晕，静谧好奇氛围

scenes.name: 单利演示
scenes.description: 左半屏浅绿底，右半屏浅黄底；时间轴横贯底部，标注0年→30年；扁平化图表区

scenes.name: 复利演示
scenes.description: 同s2构图，但右侧图表动态生长，呈现指数曲线；背景微光脉动

scenes.name: 对比总结
scenes.description: 双柱状图并列：左侧单利柱（矮、线性增长）、右侧复利柱（高、顶部带向上箭头），背景渐变为青柠绿

scenes.name: 72法则点睛
scenes.description: 纯白底，中央悬浮简洁数字‘72’，两侧展开公式图标：72 ÷ 年化收益率 = 翻倍年数；柔和阴影

shots.visual: 一个巨大、立体、微微旋转的银色问号悬浮在浅蓝色背景中央，表面反射柔光，周围漂浮3个微型金币图标，呈弧形环绕

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 为什么爱因斯坦说复利是世界第八大奇迹？

shots.imagePrompt: flat illustration style, 16:9, light blue gradient background, centered large shiny metallic question mark with soft reflection, three small flat gold coins floating in gentle arc around it, clean minimal composition, no text
shots.videoPrompt: question mark rotates slowly, coins drift gently clockwise

shots.visual: 画面左右分屏：左屏为浅绿色底，画一条从(0,10000)出发的平直蓝线，终点标‘30年：25000元’；右屏浅黄底，同起点画一条几乎重合的浅黄短线，末端标‘第一年利息：500元’；底部横轴标0–30年，刻度清晰

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 单利：每年只算本金的5%，30年后——2万5千块。

shots.imagePrompt: flat illustration style, 16:9, split screen: left panel light green background with straight horizontal blue line starting at (0,10000) and ending at (30,25000), labeled '30 years: ¥25,000'; right panel light yellow background with short horizontal yellow line from (0,10000) to (1,10500), labeled 'Year 1 interest: ¥500'; bottom timeline axis from 0 to 30 years, clean sans-serif labels, no people
shots.videoPrompt: blue line draws left-to-right, yellow line draws quickly on right

shots.visual: 同s2构图，但右屏浅黄底上，一条粗实橙色曲线从(0,10000)出发，逐年向上陡峭弯曲，30年处标‘¥43,219’；曲线上每5年有一个发光圆点，连接虚线至纵轴显示金额：15000、22500、33750、43219

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 复利：每年利息也加入本金——30年后，变成4万3千多！

shots.imagePrompt: flat illustration style, 16:9, split screen: left panel light green background with same straight blue line as before; right panel light yellow background with bold upward-curving orange exponential curve from (0,10000) to (30,43219), labeled '30 years: ¥43,219'; five glowing teal dots on curve at years 0/5/10/15/20/25/30, each connected by dashed line to y-axis showing values ¥10000/¥12763/¥16289/¥20789/¥26533/¥33864/¥43219, clean axis labels, no text beyond numbers
shots.videoPrompt: orange curve grows smoothly from start to end, dots pulse sequentially

shots.visual: 并排双柱状图：左柱浅蓝、高度对应25000，标‘单利’；右柱深橙、高度约是左柱1.7倍，顶端带金色向上箭头，标‘复利’；两柱底部共用标签‘¥10,000本金 · 5%年收益 · 30年’；背景青柠绿渐变

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 同样本金、利率、时间——复利多赚近1万8！

shots.imagePrompt: flat illustration style, 16:9, white-to-lime-green gradient background, two vertical bars side by side: left bar light blue, height proportional to ¥25,000, labeled 'Simple Interest'; right bar deep orange, height ~1.7x taller, labeled 'Compound Interest', with golden upward arrow icon above top; shared base label '¥10,000 principal · 5% annual · 30 years', clean sans-serif font, no extra elements
shots.videoPrompt: right bar rises smoothly to full height, arrow pulses once

shots.visual: 纯白背景，中央大号黑色数字‘72’，左右各延伸一条简约等式分支：左写‘72 ÷ 5% = 14.4年’，右写‘≈翻倍时间’；下方小字‘72法则：快速估算投资翻倍所需年数’；所有文字浅灰，数字加粗

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 记住72法则：72除以年化收益率，就是资金翻倍的大致年数。

shots.imagePrompt: flat illustration style, 16:9, pure white background, centered large bold black number '72', left branch with '72 ÷ 5% = 14.4 years' in light gray sans-serif, right branch with '≈ doubling time' in same style; below, smaller subtitle 'The Rule of 72: estimate doubling time fast', all text clean and legible, no icons or people
shots.videoPrompt: '72' glows softly, branches fade in left then right

shots.visual: 回归开场浅蓝背景，问号已变为一颗发亮的金色树苗，树干刻着‘¥10000’，三片叶子分别标‘+5%’‘+5%’‘+5%’，树冠舒展，散发微光粒子

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 复利不是魔法——是时间，乘以耐心，再乘以再投资。

shots.imagePrompt: flat illustration style, 16:9, light blue gradient background, centered golden sapling with glowing particles, trunk engraved '¥10,000', three leaves labeled '+5%' each, soft radiant crown, clean minimal composition
shots.videoPrompt: sapling gently sways, particles float upward

shots.visual: 双柱图淡出，浮现居中文字‘开始，永远不晚’，下方小字‘复利，偏爱坚持的人’；背景转为温暖浅杏色
